title: Edge proxy teardown leak causing silent SSE truncations; implement idempotent finalizer and SDK reconciliation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple customers reported intermittent truncated streaming responses (SSE) where clients receive a partial transcript without a deterministic final event. Impact: user-facing failures for chat UIs and background consumers (embeddings/reranking), increased escalations across Hosted and Dedicated contracts, and two Private deployments requested emergency patches. Root cause hypothesis: an interaction between L7 edge idle timeouts and the gateway's stream-finalization handshake that allowed half-closed streams to drop the final 'end' marker. Investigation found race between proxy TCP FIN handling and our runtime's finalizer flush leading to non-idempotent final events. Fix implemented: 1) server-side idempotent finalizer that stamps a final-event sentinel to persistent stream metadata before sending; 2) edge keepalive tuning and a short-lived in-memory finalizer queue that retries on transient EPIPE/ECONNRESET; 3) client SDK patch (js/py) to reconcile by fetching a finalization token when partial output is detected and to dedupe duplicate finals. Deployed hotfix to hosted (canary -> global) and produced a patch bundle for Dedicated and Private customers with upgrade steps. Added new sampling telemetry to detect silent-final ratios and latency windows around FIN packets.
resolution_summary: Hotfix deployed to hosted (runtime-1.24) with canary success metrics showing silent-final events reduced by 98% in canary tenants. Dedicated/Private customers received patch artifacts and rollback-safe instructions. SDK patch published (v2.3.1-js, v1.7.4-py) which adds deterministic finalizer reconciliation in the client. Incident report created and follow-ups scheduled.
rollback_plan: Revert runtime-1.24 canary to previous image and disable in-memory retry queue. For Dedicated/Private, apply the provided rollback script that clears finalizer queue and restarts gateway components in order. Communicate rollback window to affected tenants and set 30-minute maintenance window.
